testReports.emptyDescription: This project has no test report yet. Use [Register a report] below and enter an edition to create the first one.

empty.noProjectHint: Pick a project to see its equipment lists.

referenceData.title: Reference data
referenceData.description: The authoritative origin of the values measurements are taken against. Review a candidate and publish it; chambers measure with it from their next session.
referenceData.effectNote: Publishing takes effect when the next measurement session starts. A session already running keeps its correction curve.
referenceData.publishedNote: This revision is already published or retired. Only a candidate can be published.

diff.noBaseline: No previously published revision — this is the first publication for this scope.
diff.summary: Against the published revision: {added} added · {changed} changed · {removed} removed · {unchanged} unchanged

coupled.note: This family is paired with {sibling}. Publishing one half pairs one antenna's signal path with another's path loss and the measurement is silently wrong. Choose the matching candidate.

empty.noProviderHint: Revisions are scoped per provider. Pick one above to see the list.
empty.noRevisionsHint: Nothing is registered for this scope yet. The first load is performed by the operator tool.

error.forbidden: You do not have permission to publish reference data. Ask a project administrator.
error.notFound: That revision could not be found.
error.unavailable: The central server is unreachable. Try again shortly.
error.network: The request failed because of a network error.
error.generic: Reference data could not be loaded.
error.publishConflict: Cannot publish: another revision already holds the slot, or the matching candidate is required.
error.staleEdit: This revision changed since you loaded it, so saving would discard the other edit. Reload and re-apply your change.

referenceData.unsavedNote: {count} unsaved change(s). Save before publishing — publishing sends what is stored, not what is on screen.

provenance.workbook: Values in this edition came from the workbook import it started from.

provenance.webAuthored: This edition was authored here from scratch, with no workbook behind it.

referenceData.unreadableNote: These cells could not be read as the value they replace: {cells}. Fix them before saving — sending the raw text would put text where a number belongs.

rows.title: Add and remove rows
rows.description: Different from editing a value — a change that moves an identity cell can only be expressed as a row added and a row removed. Both halves travel in one request when you save.
rows.removalCaption: Rows in this edition (marked for removal)

create.title: Author from scratch
create.description: Create a reference edition with no workbook behind it. The server says which cells to fill. One row is required — publishing an empty edition would empty this family entirely.
